summary: Sony Japan Studio's bright tilt-and-roll puzzle-platform series, covering the PSP originals, PS3 Cocoreccho spin-off, PS4 remasters, and the Midnight Carnival emulated re-release.

entries.title: LocoRoco

emulation.emulator: Native PS4/PS5 backward compatibility; PPSSPP for PSP original
emulation.notes: Use PS4 remaster for main capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS4 remaster output up to PS4 Pro 4K support.

primary.why: The PS4 remaster is the best official route for the first LocoRoco, with native 4K support on PS4 Pro and 1080p on standard PS4.
primary.how_to_play: Play LocoRoco Remastered on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Use the PSP version only for original handheld comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but lower-fidelity than the PS4 remaster.
skip: archival mobile route, not the best main-play version.

all_releases.fidelity: PS4 remaster with 4K support on PS4 Pro and 1080p on standard PS4.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS4 remaster is the best modern route for the original game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use PSP only for original handheld presentation.

emulation.notes: PS3 hardware/owned PSN copy is the practical route.

primary.why: Cocoreccho is documented as a PS3-exclusive spin-off using PS3/SIXAXIS-style play, so the PSN PS3 release is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware with an owned PlayStation Network copy.

all_releases.fidelity: PS3 PlayStation Network release running at 1080p.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate ports or remasters are documented.

entries.title: LocoRoco Midnight Carnival

emulation.emulator: Native PS5 digital PSP emulation; PPSSPP for PSP original
emulation.notes: Use PS5 digital release for main capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS5 output of emulated PSP release.

primary.how_to_play: Play the PS5 digital release if available through PlayStation Store/Plus Premium. Use PSP/PPSSPP only for original-release comparison.
